source.title: WRC Digest (October 2023)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

Ever since the last digest provided by the WCA Regulations Committee in June, an enormous quantity of activities have been carried out by the committee, such as the development of a new set of regulations released in the month of August, as well as a considerable number of incidents  handled by the committee during the last few months. Here you have the most notable incidents:

1. During different competitions, there have been different applications of Regulation 2s, regarding competitors with circumstances, that resulted in a large amount of discussion inside and outside the committee. One of these cases resulted in a time limit being expanded due to a competitor with a circumstance, meanwhile in another one, a blind competitor was permitted to recognize the pieces of the puzzle in 3x3x3 One-Handed event with the other hand, without applying any moves. The WRC would like to remember that if this is to be done, the WCA Delegate should be paying attention to avoid any cheating by using the second hand. The WRC is also planning on specifying better the limits and permissions of 2s on the next set of regulations.

2. The WRC also had a few incidents regarding several corner twists in the same attempt. Most of these cases happened on the Megaminx event, which is known for having more corner twists than normal. Applying a literal interpretation of the 5b3c regulations that states that “If the puzzle is unsolvable, and can be made solvable by rotating a single corner piece, the competitor may correct the corner piece by twisting it in place without disassembling the puzzle”, as multiple corners had been twisted in these attempts, DNF penalties have been applied. This regulation is going to be discussed in the next cycle of regulations too.

3. In a competition, due to a scrambler’s mistake, a Pyraminx first round group had a few attempts scrambled in an incorrect orientation, the Delegates acted correctly by providing extras to everyone that was present at the competition, however, it was one of the last events in the day, so some people ended up without extra attempts. The WRC has decided that since Pyraminx is one of the easiest events to be color neutral in, and the competitors were not at fault for this mistake, the original attempts should stay for everyone, since this would result in more people having the same scrambles than three differents sets for that same group (one for the people present at the time the mistake was discovered, one for the people who were only at the competition on the next day and the incorrect one for the people that did not receive the extra attempts). The WRC would like to clarify everyone that this is **not** a precedent to allow puzzles scrambled in the wrong orientation, and if a similar case happens in another competition, the WRC should be contacted as soon as possible.

4. There were several instances of popped pieces being handed by spectators  to the competitors affected, where Delegates provided extras. The WRC would like to remind everyone that A5b++ states that if this happens, the piece should be placed on the table and no further assistance should be given. In cases like this, no extra attempts should be granted, since it would be advantageous for  the competitor to get an extra for a puzzle defect. It is easier to get a better time on an extra attempt than on an attempt with a pop.

Another news regarding the WRC:

* There have been a huge number of major championships with a large number of competitors, and all the times the WRC was present, the committee was able to provide live, if not very fast feedback to incidents regarding these competitions.
* The WRC is also already working on the next set of regulations, you may expect some news very soon!

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会工作简报（2023 年 10 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

自 WCA 规则委员会 6 月发布上一期简报以来，委员会完成了大量工作，包括制定并于 8 月发布新版规则，以及处理过去几个月里的许多意外事件。以下是几起较值得关注的事件：

1. 不同比赛对规则 2s（涉及有特殊情况的选手）的应用有所不同，在委员会内外引发了大量讨论。其中一例为有特殊情况的选手延长了时限；另一例允许一名失明选手在三阶单手项目中，用另一只手触摸辨认魔方块件，但不得进行任何转动。WRC 提醒，采用这种安排时，WCA 代表应留意选手的动作，防止利用第二只手作弊。WRC 也计划在下一版规则中进一步明确 2s 的适用边界和允许范围。

2. WRC 还处理了几起同一次尝试中发生多次角块扭转的事件。多数发生在五魔项目，该项目比一般项目更容易发生角块扭转。规则 5b3c 写道：“如果魔方处于不可还原的状态，而原地扭转一个角块即可使其可还原，选手可以在不拆解魔方的情况下，原地扭转该角块进行修正。”按这一条文的字面含义，由于相关尝试中不止一个角块发生扭转，这些成绩被判为 DNF。下一轮规则修订也会讨论这一条。

3. 一场比赛中，由于打乱员的失误，金字塔第一轮某组的部分尝试使用了错误朝向打乱。代表为所有仍在赛场的选手安排补赛，这一处理是正确的。但金字塔是当天最后几个项目之一，部分选手最终没能获得补赛。WRC 决定为所有人保留原成绩，原因是金字塔属于较容易做到色中性的项目，而且错误不在选手。这样能让更多人使用相同打乱，而不是同一组出现三套不同打乱：发现错误时仍在场的人一套、次日才回到赛场的人一套，以及没有获得补赛的人使用的原错误打乱。WRC 明确说明，这**不**是允许错误朝向打乱的先例；其他比赛若发生类似情况，应尽快联系 WRC。

4. 有几起事件中，观众把飞出的块件递给选手，代表因此安排了补赛。WRC 提醒大家，A5b++ 规定，这种情况下应将块件放在桌上，不得提供进一步协助。此类情况不应给予补赛，因为让选手因魔方故障获得补赛会带来优势：在补赛中取得好成绩，比在发生飞棱的尝试中取得好成绩容易。

WRC 的其他近况：

* 近期举办了许多参赛人数众多的大型锦标赛。凡有 WRC 成员在场的比赛，委员会都能对事件即时或很快给出反馈。
* WRC 已开始制定下一版规则，很快就会有更多消息！
